name: examples
description: One hand-written customer-support case: check in seconds that the tool works with your model. Each relation is scored from one test (min_n 1), so its numbers are a demonstration, not a result; use jevbench-mini (or jevbench-240).

rewrites.written_by: Claude, one rewrite per source, reviewed against the same standard as jevbench-240's audit (2026-10-01); not human-audited

plan.selection: each relation tested once per case, one variant per test
